paragraphs: Pioneer, the maker of many of our favorite CarPlay head units, is expanding into iPhone accessories for the first time. The company has launched a full lineup of in-car iPhone gear, including a MagSafe wireless charger and phone mount.

Pioneer has made great gear over the years, so it’s interesting to see it expand into more traditional iPhone accessories. My go-to recommendation for an in-car USB-C charger is one with a retractable cable. The one I use appears to have been discontinued, but this one from UGREEN is a great alternative.
You can shop Pioneer’s lineup of new iPhone accessories on Amazon. What are some of your favorite in-car iPhone accessories? Let us know down in the comments.
